verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a USDC stablecoin balance in Treasury Financial Accounts that can receive, store, and send funds, though this is in public preview. Bridge orchestration programmatically supports on-ramps and off-ramps, which is the closest evidence of fiat↔stablecoin conversion. None of the evidence describes internal transfers or rebalancing between a business's own fiat and stablecoin balances via API or dashboard. Stablecoin payouts convert only at payout time, leaving the platform balance in fiat. Missing for 10: explicit documented internal fiat↔stablecoin transfer/rebalancing flow, dashboard support for rebalancing, end-to-end API documentation of the conversion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
